stops.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
stops.why: Where Perseverance began its mission on Mars, on the floor of Jezero Crater.
stops.source_name: NASA/JPL, Perseverance drives on Mars terrain for first time
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 13, the last fix on or before sol 13. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Wright Brothers Field
stops.why: Ingenuity flew here first, making this the first of many airfields on other worlds.
stops.source_name: NASA/JPL, Ingenuity succeeds in historic first flight

stops.name: Rochette (Citadelle)
stops.why: First rock cores of the mission, igneous samples Montdenier and Montagnac from the crater floor.
stops.source_name: NASA/JPL, Perseverance's journey to first successful sample collection
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 180, the last fix on or before sol 194. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Brac (Seitah)
stops.why: Second sample pair, Salette and Coulettes, from the crater floor region called Seitah.
stops.source_name: NASA Science, To Seitah and Back
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 248, the last fix on or before sol 262. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Skinner Ridge
stops.why: Layered delta rocks, including sandstone with grains carried in from far outside the crater.
stops.source_name: NASA, Perseverance investigates geologically rich Mars terrain
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 477, the last fix on or before sol 490. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Wildcat Ridge
stops.why: Delta mudstone where SHERLOC registered the most abundant organic detections of the mission to that date.
stops.source_name: NASA, Perseverance investigates geologically rich Mars terrain
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 502, the last fix on or before sol 509. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
stops.why: Perseverance's first depot: 10 sample tubes selected to be left on the surface here.
stops.source_name: NASA Science, A map of Perseverance's samples
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 652, the last fix on or before sol 653. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Comet Geyser (Bunsen Peak)
stops.why: Sample 24, a rock core that NASA's sample table lists as a silica-cemented carbonate.
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 1084, the last fix on or before sol 1088. Not the exact outcrop.

stops.name: Cheyava Falls (Bright Angel)
stops.why: Source of the Sapphire Canyon core, which contains potential biosignatures. This is not a confirmation of life.
stops.source_name: NASA/JPL, Mars rover discovered potential biosignature
stops.coord_note: Rover position on sol 1210, the last fix on or before sol 1215. Not the exact outcrop.
